Known quirk: in shortcuts.vdf the `StartDir` value of entry 0 (AppidProbe) starts with a space before the opening quote (` "/home/user/.../x86_64-windows/"`). It is in Steam's own file (the raw snapshot has the same byte), dates from the hand-entered Start In of row 12, and is kept byte-verbatim; whether Steam or the typed text added it was not measured, and entry 1 (Battle.net) has no such space. A parser must not assume `StartDir` begins with a quote.
